scripts/lab/adhoc/oatver.py.purpose: Extracts embedded three-digit OAT versions from supplied binary files.

scripts/lab/adhoc/thread_sched_tap.sh.purpose: Injects a fixed tap and compares main-thread and fixed-vsync-thread schedstat before and after an eight-second wait.

scripts/lab/adhoc/thread_sched_trace.sh.purpose: Injects a fixed tap and samples two supplied threads' schedstat and the first thread's wait channel 24 times.

scripts/lab/adhoc/vsync_threads.sh.purpose: Compares schedstat snapshots five seconds apart for named vsync, RenderThread and Thread-2 threads.

scripts/lab/apply_touchfix_8.py.purpose: Patches the input bridge to select the Android root under a display-space tap and translate the tap into that root's local coordinates.

scripts/lab/candidate_first_fatal.py.purpose: Extracts and clusters first-fatal evidence from window5 runs for keys not lit in the U9 sign-off.

scripts/lab/deploy_generation.sh.purpose: Forwards arguments to the adjacent deploy_generation.py deployment executor.

scripts/lab/provenance_static100.py.purpose: Checks runtime-lock hashes against local build outputs and records provider library and source provenance for the static-100 audit.

scripts/lab/render_static100.py.purpose: Renders the static-100 audit, gap analysis and verification data into comparison tables and the report.

scripts/lab/static100_tooling_smoke.py.purpose: Asserts selected-ABI symbol isolation, XML namespace precedence and recovery of all 22 PayPal provider identities.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_cleanup.py.purpose: Patches touch diagnostics to require WL_TOUCH_TRACE rather than print unconditionally.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_comments.py.purpose: Rewrites input-bridge comments to describe display-to-window coordinate routing and Android window eligibility.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_diagnostic.py.purpose: Replaces the selected-root log call with stderr diagnostics and an immediate flush.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_flags.py.purpose: Patches root selection to read LayoutParams flags and reject windows with FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_layer.py.purpose: Patches root priority to use Android window type ahead of insertion order and focus, because insertion order is not reliable Z-order.

scripts/lab/verify_static100.py.purpose: Recomputes locked static-100 input, native resolution and gap-map checks and records mismatches.

scripts/lab/touchfix8_rebuild.sh.purpose: Archives the previous touchfix outputs, recompiles bridge sources, links platform/media/appspawn components and composes the updated native runtime.

scripts/lab/build_extras.sh.purpose: Builds and packages the OpenGL-JNI and missing-natives libraries that the manifest build does not produce.

scripts/lab/build_runtime_helpers.sh.purpose: Builds and packages six public-SDK runtime helpers and the asset bridge absent from manifest-composed native runtime.

scripts/lab/reproduce_dex2oat_toolchain..purpose: Verifies the frozen AOSP patch series, reproduces dex2oat and 27 boot-image outputs, and runs rb/t4b gates.

scripts/lab/watch_pane_idle.sh.purpose: Watches a pane without events.jsonl and reports when it leaves working state or disappears.

scripts/lab/oatdump_remote.sh.purpose: Synchronizes images and BCP JARs to the build host, runs the matching host oatdump and returns its output and exit code.

origins.scripts/lab/run_facts.py: ACKs reported screenshots/liveness without counting retained captures (#63/#71/#76); count captured slots and UID process tables and quote facts verbatim (DIGEST:383; RUNBOOK:130).
origins.scripts/lab/compare_runs.py: FLAW-008 attributed failures to one cause without a controlled comparison; enumerate board/reboot/artifact variables before naming a cause (first-add subject; RUNBOOK:145).
origins.scripts/lab/deployed_class_diff.py: T8 rebuilt stubs on an underlay instead of the effective deployed JAR, dropping frozen classes despite other gates passing; compare against the deployed class set and reject ambiguous same-name copies (DIGEST:625).
origins.scripts/lab/activation_smoke.py: A fix must be observed live before a full sweep; the first smoke run caught the absent J9-NOTITLE marker while other checks passed (first-add subject; RUNBOOK:46).
origins.scripts/lab/board_run.py: Hand-written dispatches omitted hilog, overlapped same-board shards and lost required steps; make lock, smoke, sequential runs, facts and recovery one fixed runner (header; RUNBOOK:45).
origins.scripts/lab/artifact_identity.py: EVO-0053 and repeated conclusions reasoned from local binaries whose hashes did not match deployed artifacts; establish exact deployed identity before interpretation (header and first-add subject).
origins.scripts/lab/deployed_strings_diff.py: U10's rebuilt policy lost libsoundpool.so from the deployed U9 system-library list while exports/NEEDED looked unchanged; compare deployed strings, not a reproduced baseline (header).
origins.scripts/lab/board_append.sh: EVO-0034 reported a sign-off after passing body text as ignored arguments to the stdin-only append tool; reject empty bodies and read the board back (header; DIGEST:384).
origins.scripts/lab/board_acks.py: Anchored ACK scans missed replies whose ACK was not at line start; scan ACK anywhere and associate the nearest entry heading (header).
origins.scripts/lab/board_cursor.sh: Rearming a latest-lines watcher lost entries posted between sentinel completion and rearming; retain a persistent read cursor (header).
origins.scripts/lab/check_user_paths.py: User rule 2026-09-30 forbids scripts bound to a person's home path; reject such paths except exact registry entries (header; RUNBOOK:23).
origins.scripts/lab/check_frozen.py: The public-API freeze rule prevents silently changing already-validated fixes; bind checks to recorded source/artifact identities (header; AGENTS.md).
origins.scripts/lab/land.py: Lane worktree indexes were unwritable in the workspace sandbox; submit an explicit path manifest for atomic outer-loop landing and gates (header).
origins.scripts/lab/run_index.py: Existing maps/hilog evidence could already answer double-load and unknown-session hypotheses but was repeatedly recollected; index runs for offline queries (header).
origins.scripts/lab/stray_board_check.sh: EVO-0060 handoffs were written to a stray worktree board that the outer loop never read; detect noncanonical board writes (header).
origins.scripts/lab/unlanded.py: A delivery sat unreviewed for 70 minutes while patrol read only newest board lines; reconcile delivery lists against master (header).
origins.scripts/lab/vm_runner_watch.sh: B4 runners died with lock/FileExistsError/TypeError while lanes waited; the outer loop watches logs for newly appearing Tracebacks (header).
origins.scripts/lab/zig_prefetch_build.sh: Zig HTTP fetching failed through the proxy; fetch pinned dependencies with curl into Zig's content-addressed cache before retrying (header).
origins.scripts/lab/bcp_duplicate_classes.py: T7c CheckSystemClass was later identified as an image/JAR checksum mismatch, not duplicate classes; this supplementary G3 gate rejects unapproved duplicates without claiming to fix that cause (header).

chains.incident: ACK screenshot and liveness claims were not backed by captures (#63/#71/#76).
chains.rule: Count retained evidence and quote facts verbatim; screenshot capture does not itself prove a lit UI.

chains.incident: FLAW-008: single-cause attribution without a control.
chains.rule: Enumerate changed variables; only a single-variable comparison supports attribution, and zero-variable flips need repeat trials.

chains.incident: Hand-written board dispatches omitted --hilog, overlapped shards and omitted required retention/recovery steps.
chains.rule: Encode the dispatch as one fixed plan-driven lock/smoke/run/facts/recovery workflow.

chains.incident: A hand-written full-sweep dispatch ran with two fixes that had never activated; the first smoke-gate trial then caught the missing J9-NOTITLE marker.
chains.rule: Verify each fix is active before a full sweep; compilation and identity alone do not prove activation.

chains.incident: T8 rebuilt against an underlay JAR instead of effective f3bcc9d7, losing FZ-007/FZ-008 classes despite rb/t4b/G1/G2 passing.
chains.rule: Diff candidate classes and frozen class shape against the effective deployed JAR; reject ambiguous baselines.
